sentences.text:
The petitioners are before this Court seeking for the following reliefs:
"Quash the FIR dated 01/06/2018 in Crime No. 0108/2018 registered by Wilson Garden Police Station on the filing of complaint dated 01/06/2018 offence punishable under Section 408, 420, 468 and 471 of IPC pending on the file of 4th Addl. CMM Court, Bengaluru, vide ANNEXURE-"A" and "B" and any ancillary actions pursuant to the Impugned FIR in the interest of justice and equity."
2. A complaint was lodged on 01.06.2018 by respondent No.2 before the Wilson Garden Police Station Respondent No.1, on which basis Crime No.108/2018 was registered for the offenses punishable under Sections 408, 420, 468, 471 of the IPC pending on the file of IV Additional CMM,
Bengaluru 3.

The allegation made in the complaint against the petitioners alleging that M/s. Next Radio Limited, of which the petitioners are officers, had raised, fabricated invoice on respondent No.2 calling upon respondent No.2 to make payments.
Believing the same to be true, respondent No.2 made payments for the amounts claimed.

Subsequently, realizing that no services has NC:
2024:KHC:10476 claimed had been rendered and the amounts paid were not so due.
As such, the aforesaid complaint was filed.
4. Respondent Nos.2 has also filed a suit in O.S.No.8485/2018 for recovery of the said amounts.
In the said suit, a settlement has been arrived at in terms of a settlement agreement dated 22.12.2022.
In pursuance of which, the parties have resolved their disputes and the suit has also been withdrawn.
5. In that view of the matter, being of the considered opinion that the dispute is essentially civil in nature and there are no criminal ingredients made out in the present complaint.
The essential character of the dispute being the recovery of money allegedly due from the petitioners by respondent No.2, no ingredients for the aforesaid offences being made out.

I pass the following:
::ORDER::
i) The petition is allowed.
ii) The FIR dated 01.06.2018 in Crime No.10.08.2018 registered by the Wilson Garden Police Station for offences punishable under Sections 408, 420, 468 NC:
2024:KHC:10476 and 471 of pending on the file of the IV Additional CMM

,
Bengaluru is hereby quashed.

iii) In view of dismissal of the main petition, pending interlocutory applications do not survive for consideration and the same stands disposed of.
